evidence.excerpt: We introduce CavaBench, the first internally collected benchmark of spoken financial queries, and use it to evaluate a range of ASR models and their end-to-end ASR-LLM pipeline behaviour across self-reported British accents.

evidence.excerpt: We find that WER strongly predicts downstream tool-calling accuracy ($r = -0.93$) but can fail to reflect task-level performance, with accent-related failures varying substantially across models and acoustic conditions.
